title: Bijectivity of the prescribed scalar-extension twist map on the complete standard chart
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sfb-proj-scalar-extension-twist-chart, for every positive-degree homogeneous f, the prescribed twist map is bijective on sections over the complete standard open D_+(psi(f)).

source.place: Tag 01N2 (lemma-base-change-map-proj), clause (3), standard-open calculation; Tag 01MY (lemma-morphism-proj), localized graded-module formula

proof.text: Identify the two twists on the complete standard charts with shifted homogeneous localized graded modules, apply the affine pullback-sections identification, and compose the homogeneous localization scalar-extension equivalences. The prescribed pointwise formula agrees with this composite, giving bijectivity on the complete chart.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01N2, standard-open proof, extracted as the complete-chart subproblem
